source: Netfly HDR community directory — curated list of real, public Stremio addons and Nuvio plugin repositories. Every entry is validated against its live manifest before install; entries whose manifest cannot be fetched show as Unavailable. Scraper counts are NOT baked in here — the store reads them from the live manifest so they never go stale.
